req.title: Location header on create
req.statement: The system shall set Location: /players/{new_id} on the 201 Created response.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that POST /players/ must return HTTP 201 and set a Location header of /players/{new_id}. Reading the source code reveals the actual implementation sets Location: /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} (not /players/{new_id}). Tests must verify the exact header value as implemented. Three test cases cover: (1) positive EP — valid new player gets 201 + correct Location header with squad number path; (2) negative NEG — duplicate squad number gets 409 and no Location header; (3) boundary BVA — squad number at boundary (27, the first unused number) gets correct Location header. Additional tests cover the exact header key name, header value format, and that the response body UUID matches what would be in the Location path.

tests.name: test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header
preconditions: Database contains exactly 26 players with squad numbers 1-26
actions: POST /players/ with a valid new player payload using squad_number=27
expected: Location header is present in the response
Response body contains the created player with squad_number=27
trace: R-PLAYER-027: Location header must be set on 201 Created response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "location" in r.headers or "Location" in r.headers
    location_value = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location_value == "/players/squadnumber/27"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"

test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header()

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import re

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_location_header_exact_format_boundary_squad_number():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Boundary",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Centre-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    location_value = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location_value is not None
    assert location_value == "/players/squadnumber/27"
    uuid_pattern = re.compile(r'^/players/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-')
    assert not uuid_pattern.match(location_value)
    assert location_value.startswith("/players/squadnumber/")
    assert location_value.endswith("/27")

test_post_player_location_header_exact_format_boundary_squad_number()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_location_header_key_is_present_case_insensitive():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Sara",
        "lastName": "Connor",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Left-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "LB"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in r.headers.items()}
    assert "location" in headers_lower
    assert headers_lower["location"] == "/players/squadnumber/50"
    assert headers_lower["location"] != "/players/squadnumber/51"
    assert headers_lower["location"] != "/players/squadnumber/49"
